text: Question: How do I unsubscribe from a Value Added Service (VAS) I didn't request? Answer: ### Short Answer Go to My Subscriptions in the app to view all active VAS (caller tunes, content packs, insurance add-ons, etc.) and deactivate any you did not authorise. Unauthorised VAS activation can also be reported via Complaints for a refund review, per TRAI's consent-based subscription rules. ### Detailed Explanation The distinction here is between removing a VAS yourself (self-service, under My Subscriptions) and disputing that it was ever authorised in the first place (a complaint, since it concerns consent) — the second path exists specifically because TRAI's consent-based rules mean unauthorised activation can be grounds for a refund review, which simple deactivation alone doesn't provide. ### Key Details | Detail | Value | |---|---| | Where to deactivate | My Subscriptions in the app | | VAS types covered | Caller tunes, content packs, insurance add-ons, etc. | | If unauthorised | Report via Complaints for a refund review, under TRAI's consent-based subscription rules | ### Conditions - Deactivating alone stops future charges; a refund for past charges specifically requires reporting it as unauthorised via Complaints. ### Escalation Reporting an unauthorised VAS through Complaints is the documented route to a refund review, separate from simply deactivating the service. ### Example Scenario **Customer situation:** A customer finds a content-pack subscription on their account they never signed up for and has already been charged. **What happens:** Deactivating it under My Subscriptions stops further charges, but recovering
